title: Chapter 355 Master
content:
Chapter 355 Master

No matter what the leaders of the coalition forces think, the war will still go on.

As the 5,000 troops from the dojo once again pressed into the battlefield, the coalition forces, which had already been exhausted after repeated battles, couldn't bear it all at once, and there were large-scale defeats, and even some routs.

After only a moment of fighting, the coalition forces retreated tens of meters. In the back, with the intensification of the dojo's offensive, it was pushed from the center of the battlefield to the edge, and the defeats appeared in batches.

I saw countless dozens or hundreds of coalition soldiers crying, led by their respective leaders, or simply killed the leader who blocked them, and retreated aimlessly towards the rear.

The situation is irreversible.

Up to now, the tens of thousands of coalition forces have only left more than 6,000 people, and more than 4,000 of these 6,000 people are being defeated. Morale is extremely low, and it is useless without a day or two of rectification.

The remaining 2,000 people are still actively resisting out of loyalty, but it is irrelevant to the overall situation.

Under the encirclement and suppression of the dojo army with more than 5,000 people left, they were about to be completely overthrown.

However, they were also not completely wiped out, because the only remaining tens of thousands of cannon fodder on the rear side of the coalition forces had all been caught up by the respective bosses of the coalition forces.

In contrast, there are also 10,000 cannon fodder left in the dojo whose strength has not yet reached the first level. Compared with the tens of thousands of cannon fodder in the coalition army, these people are far superior in strength.

Not long after the battle, these coalition reinforcements who had just been sent to the battlefield were defeated, most of them fled, and nearly 4,000 people were beheaded.

In the end, only four or five thousand people were able to return to the coalition camp.

At this point, no matter whether it is the coalition or the dojo, they have not sent troops to continue to support and maintain this cruel meat grinder.

In addition to the fact that both sides suffered too much damage and the morale of the soldiers underneath was too severe, it was a bit unbearable, and the war had been fought for a whole day, and the soldiers on both sides were very tired.

Moreover, it was getting late. In this era when most people suffer from lack of nutrition and night blindness, fighting at night is definitely a nightmare.

Moreover, after the battle, the two sides have already figured out their respective strengths, and have a roughly clear prediction of the direction of the next war. If you continue to fight, you will lose your strength in vain, and it will not be taken by the wise.

The coalition forces have already ascertained the strength of the army on the opposite side. Although they are stronger than themselves, it is not impossible to resist the price of depleting the potential of the entire Shinano country.

So their goal has been achieved, and it's useless to try again, and retreating has become the best choice.

After these successive battles, the dojo army has gained a firm foothold and has a foothold in the Shinano country.

What's more, after several battles, a large number of allied forces have been wiped out, which has given them a great advantage over the allied forces. Naturally, they are not in a hurry to destroy them this day.

In the end, when the two sides left the battlefield and counted their numbers, their respective losses were presented to their respective chief officials.

Among them, let alone the coalition forces, which suffered the most losses.

Among the 50,000 army, more than 30,000 cannon fodder were lost, and only 8,000 cannon fodder remained in the end. Moreover, these people were panicked, and they no longer had the courage to fight those blue demons on the opposite side. Without a few days of comfort, it was impossible to expect them to go to the battlefield.

The rest are 10,000 elites, of which 2,000 have reached the second level of strength, and the remaining 8,000 are also elites whose strength has reached the first level, which is the real foundation of these coalition forces.

On the coalition side, there are still about 25,000 to 6,000 left. Among them, there are 5,000 second-tier elites, about 10,000 first-tier elites, and another 10,000 cannon fodder. Their strength far exceeds that of the opposing coalition forces.

With this kind of strength, basically the outcome of this war has been clearly seen.

In the next few days, the battle continued every day, and the degree of tragedy was not inferior to that of a few days ago, but the scale was much smaller.

However, in the ensuing war, the strength displayed by each army was extraordinary, and it truly reflected the confrontation between the two great powers.

After all, this is a world with extraordinary power.

And as a life-and-death battle between the two major forces, there are naturally a large number of strong people gathered.

Those ordinary second-tier warriors are nothing, at most they are masters with a little bit of internal strength.

They can't escape the shackles of mortal bodies, and they still fight with each move, but their speed is much faster, and they can use dozens of moves in the blink of an eye, which is several times that of ordinary people.

And the jumping ability is very strong, it can span tens of meters in one jump, coupled with the increased strength brought about by the addition of internal force, and the body's recovery power is much higher than that of ordinary people, the strength is really strong, and it can rival countless people. Ten ordinary people.

However, even so, the power these people can exert is still within the acceptable range of ordinary people.

For a war with a scale of tens of thousands of people, the effect it can play is really not as big as imagined.

What really makes those ordinary people feel desperate is that those high-level warriors whose strength is as strong as the third level, or even the fourth level, join the battle.

Compared with the second-level masters, although the third-level masters have no major breakthroughs, their inner strength is several times ten times that of the second-level masters.

Moreover, a Tier 3 master can also release internal force outward, concentrate a lifetime of internal force on a certain weapon, and then greatly increase the power of the weapon, which can be called a terrifying killing machine.

After these masters join the battlefield, they can kill several people at every turn, and their persistence is extremely strong.

Usually a war ends, but when they kill hundreds of people, for those ordinary soldiers, the pressure they bring is extremely great.

If both sides had masters of this level and could restrain each other, I am afraid that soldiers without such masters on either side would definitely collapse and run away!

What really made those soldiers feel desperate was the existence whose strength reached level four or above, and they could no longer be called human beings.

In the eyes of those soldiers, a person with such force is no different from a god.

The existence of this kind of strength can be called a cannonball on the battlefield, and dozens of people will die in just a few gestures. After a war, almost hundreds of people will end up in the hands of these people.

Although there are many people on both sides, and each has tens of thousands of people, they cannot withstand the random consumption of such a powerful existence.

Fortunately, there are still too few sides with such force.

Although there are more than 60 people above the fourth level in the entire Shinano Kingdom, there are only more than 20 people who can really be controlled by the coalition forces and wait to be called.
